intro.title: BridgeWise
intro.say: Meet BridgeWise. One money account for international students, with an AI assistant that prepares every payment, and never moves money without your approval.

signup.title: Step 1 · Create an account
signup.line: A student from Pakistan, studying in China
signup.say: Let's start as Ayesha, a student from Pakistan studying in China. She creates an account with her email and a password. Her home country and her country of study set up her currency pockets.

home.title: An empty wallet, on purpose
home.line: Money only enters through a real payment rail
home.say: Her wallet starts empty. In BridgeWise, money only enters through a real payment rail.

addmoney.title: Step 2 · Add money
addmoney.line: Alipay’s own cashier, or a bank card through Stripe
addmoney.say: She adds money. There are two rails: Alipay's own cashier, or a bank card through Stripe.

card.title: Step 2 · Pay by card
card.line: The card field is Stripe’s own: the number never reaches BridgeWise
card.say: She pays eight hundred yuan by card. The card field belongs to Stripe, so her card number never reaches BridgeWise.

card_ok.title: Confirmed by Stripe
card_ok.line: Credited only after BridgeWise asks Stripe
card_ok.say: The pocket is credited only after BridgeWise asks Stripe whether the payment really succeeded.

alipay.title: The Alipay rail
alipay.say: Paying with Alipay opens Alipay's official cashier. Again, the wallet is credited only after Alipay confirms the trade.

link.title: Step 3 · Link accounts
link.line: Cards, Alipay, WeChat Pay, CCB, ICBC, Bank of China
link.say: Next, she links her accounts: bank cards, Alipay, WeChat Pay, and Chinese banks such as C C B, I C B C and Bank of China.

link_ok.title: Alipay linked
link_ok.line: Money can now move out to it for real
link_ok.say: Her Alipay is linked, so money can now move out to it for real.

convert.title: Step 4 · Convert
convert.line: Live ECB rate, fee shown first
convert.say: She converts a hundred yuan to rupees. The live European Central Bank rate, and BridgeWise's fee, are shown before anything happens.

approve.title: Nothing moves until you approve
approve.line: Every card carries a fingerprint of its exact terms
approve.say: Nothing moves until she approves. Each card carries a fingerprint of its exact terms.

send.title: Step 5 · Pay someone in China
send.line: Only the student can add recipients
send.say: Now she pays a friend in China. Recipients are Alipay accounts, and only Ayesha can add them, so no message or invoice can trick the assistant into paying someone new.

password.title: Real money needs your password
password.line: A session alone can’t send money
password.say: Sending real money needs her password again. A signed in session alone cannot send money.

sent.title: Paid through Alipay
sent.line: The statement keeps Alipay’s order number
sent.say: Done. Alipay's transfer system paid her friend, and the statement keeps Alipay's order number.

assistant.title: Step 6 · The AI assistant
assistant.line: Paste an invoice: it reads it and prepares the payment
assistant.say: Here is the AI assistant. Ayesha pastes her tuition invoice. The assistant reads it, checks her balances, and prepares the payment.

assistant_card.title: A proposal, not an action
assistant_card.line: The assistant proposes; only the student executes
assistant_card.say: It proposes, but it cannot act. Only Ayesha executes.

setaside.title: Set aside for the university
setaside.line: Ring-fenced until she pays the university’s portal
setaside.say: The university has no Alipay account, so BridgeWise sets the exact amount aside, ring fenced until she pays through the university's own portal.

bills.title: Step 7 · Bills
bills.line: Mark it paid once the portal confirms
bills.say: In Bills, she marks it paid once the portal confirms.

activity.title: Step 8 · Statement
activity.line: Every movement, with the balance after it
activity.say: Her statement shows every movement, in plain words, with the balance after it.

budget.title: Step 9 · Budget
budget.line: Expenses paid elsewhere, budgets and runway
budget.say: She logs spending she paid elsewhere, like the campus canteen, and sees where her money goes, and how long it will last.

credit.title: Step 10 · Build credit in China
credit.line: 征信 · 芝麻信用 · 微信支付分 — a plan, never a fake score
credit.say: Foreign students arrive in China with no credit history. BridgeWise gives her a step by step plan for the P B O C credit report, Sesame Credit, and WeChat Pay Score. A plan, never a fake score.

markets.title: Step 11 · Markets
markets.line: 30 days of ECB rates, with alerts
markets.say: Markets tracks thirty days of exchange rates for her currencies, with rate alerts.

zh.title: Step 12 · 中文
zh.line: 整个界面支持简体中文
zh.say: And the whole app works in Chinese.
zh.sayZh: 整个界面支持简体中文。

outro.title: BridgeWise
outro.say: BridgeWise. Real payment rails, an assistant that never moves money without you, built for students who live across borders.
